description: Minimal ASP.NET Core (.NET 11) on the ioxide io_uring transport (ioxide.Kestrel via UseIoxide(), default reactor count). Same app as aspnet-minimal — only the Kestrel transport differs. TLS (json-tls, h2-over-TLS) and HTTP/3 are not yet enabled: the ioxide transport's HTTP-over-TLS path is a tracked follow-up.
